data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word "bazyah", which means 'to glorify, praise, or extol'. In Islamic context, Bayza is a beautiful name for a girl, symbolizing praise and glorification of Allah. The name Bayza carries the meaning “Glorifier” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bayza usually hope their child will grow to embody glorifier and live with faith, good character and purpose.
